svg.title: Attn hybrid grid with moe ep domains
svg.desc: Attn hybrid grid with moe ep domains
svg.text: The two communication phases use different-sized groups
Group and bytes for each step (TP4 × DP8 × EP32, k=8)
Steps 1/4: DP reduces B to B/8; TP uses 4 GPUs, so c₄ = 3/4.
Vs. TP32: 3.875 B·d; DP32: 0.484 B·d. Hybrid adds 0.19, cuts KV copies 32→4.
